controlPlaneCgroupMemory.formula: Independent minima of physical total and finite visible limits; physical available and max(0, limit-current) at every visible ancestor. No memory.stat, RSS, swap, high limit or scheduling reservation subtraction.
controlPlaneCgroupMemory.scope: Same observer/target cgroup and mount namespaces; only already-owned live control-plane role candidates. Raw membership and mount paths are hash-only; missing values stay explicit.
controlPlaneCgroupMemory.selfCost: Additional sampler reads/CPU are included in wrapper RUSAGE_SELF. Shared cgroup usage may include observer work; self-cost is not subtracted from memory counters.
limitations: The 50 ms time budget is cooperative between synchronous reads, not a hard filesystem-read interruption.
Sequential sampled counters are not atomic and do not reproduce any prior admission decision.
Visibility ends at the process-visible mount root; hidden ancestors are not inferred.
Missing limit files are recorded as missing and skipped only to match product semantics; they are not claimed unlimited.
Role follows existing process-name classification after descendant/PID-start ownership proof, not executable-byte verification.

baseline: post-start; no pre-run idle baseline observed
scope: Exact driver descendants by PID/starttime, plus exact instance/managed/image-verified Docker containers. No command lines, environments, mount paths or provider payloads recorded.
limitations: Sum of process RSS double-counts shared pages; it is not unique physical memory.
Container cgroup memory is separate and must not be added to container process RSS.
Docker daemon/shared kernel/VM overhead is unassigned; host memory includes unrelated work.
Processes starting and exiting between 1 Hz samples may be missed; delta counters cover observed intervals only.
Post-driver-exit settlement is not an application idle baseline.
No UI input latency, other-app responsiveness or model reasoning quality is measured.
